text:
maya: heads up — main CI went red right after #5421 merged. failing job: gpu-smoke-matrix (cuda12/pytorch-2.2)
maya: link: https://ci.internal/red/4827
ci-bot: Job 4827 FAILED — smoke/gpu/attention_integration_test (exit code 137)
maya: can someone pick this up? the merge was small, but this test is flaky. @sasha last touched the attention test matrix.
sasha: on it, grabbing logs now. any rerun requests?
tom: i'll kick a rerun for job 4827 now (manual rerun).
ci-bot: Rerun 4827 triggered by tom — new job 4830 queued.
rachel: FYI I saw a very similar OOM in nightly yesterday on cuda12 when seq_len=8192. might be cache sizing.
sasha: digging into 4827 logs — seeing kv cache alloc spike right before OOM. attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:02:15Z ERROR runtime: KVCache::reserve failed: CUDA out of memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/attention_integration.py", line 214, in test_long_context
    generate(...)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
sasha: also noticed run was on a smaller instance variant (g4dn.x). odd routing.
maya: were any routing changes pushed with that merge? the rollout was for a small infra config tweak.
tom: merge 5421 only touched docs + a small yaml lint change in .github/workflows — shouldn't affect routing.
rachel: could be autoscaler bumped a smaller instance due to burst policies. i'll check deployment events.
ci-bot: Job 4830 STARTED — running smoke/gpu/attention_integration_test
ci-bot: Job 4830 FAILED — same OOM at ~12:05Z
sasha: ack, same stack. bisect might help. does anyone have time to bisect these scheduler/alloc combos?
tom: I can start a quick bisect across recent autoscaler commits — but need to know the suspected window.
rachel: autoscaler changes merged in 5418 and 5419 earlier this morning. 5418 touched instance selection logic.
sasha: starting local bisect between commits 5417..5420 to repro with our mini-gpu cluster.
maya: if bisect repros, can we pin the job to the larger instance as a short-term workaround? we should keep prod apps healthy.
ci-bot: Job 4835 STARTED (manual rerun pinned to p3.2xlarge)
ci-bot: Job 4835 PASSED — smoke/gpu/attention_integration_test
maya: great — pinned rerun passed. that suggests instance sizing is the immediate factor.
rachel: confirmed autoscaler logs show a temporary pool shrink at 11:59Z, we routed 4827 to a cheaper node pool. looks like burst spill-over.
sasha: bisect update: my local bisect shows commit 5418 changes instance scoring to prefer smaller-general nodes when available. reverting that check locally prevents the OOM repro.
tom: nice find. can we do a canary revert in infra-config or add a guard for gpu-bound jobs?
maya: propose: 1) short-term pin gpu smoke matrix to p3 for master CI, 2) revert 5418 + add gating test for instance selection, 3) open an infra PR to enforce gpu affinity for those matrix jobs.
ci-bot: Issue created: INFRA-2987 — "Revert/guard instance selection change causing gpu OOMs" by maya
ci-bot: PR 5432 opened by tom — "pin gpu-smoke-matrix to p3 in CI" (link)
sasha: I'll push a revert PR for 5418 and add a unit test that simulates long seq kv cache usage.
rachel: oncall-rotation: tagging you in case followups are needed during the revert rollout.
oncall-rotation: saw the thread, i'll monitor alerting and can escalate to infra if the revert impacts scale-up behavior.
maya: thanks everyone. if no blockers, let's merge the pin PR to get main green, then follow up with revert + tests.
sasha: agreed. merging pin now.
ci-bot: PR 5432 MERGED by maya — main CI should re-run pinned pipeline automatically.
ci-bot: New pipeline started for main (pinned gpu-smoke-matrix) — job 4840 queued.
ci-bot: Job 4840 PASSED — main CI back to green. :tada:
maya: marking this resolved for now. filing postmortem note in #postmortems later. thanks team :heart:
